source._php_version_note: composer.json requires php ^8.2.0 (config.platform.php 8.2.0) and no locked composer package needs more; upstream's dev Dockerfile uses php:8.3-apache. Since 2026-10-10 the image runs Ubuntu 24.04's own PHP 8.3 (it reports 8.3.6; Ubuntu backports security fixes into it) instead of the official php:8.4-apache-bookworm image, whose Debian 12 base our cerodeo-v1 scan grades F on vulnerabilities Debian does not fix. PHP 8.4 on Ubuntu 24.04 would need a third-party archive (a PPA): a supply-chain decision, not taken here; preflight check_php BLOCKs a retarget whose source needs more than the image's PHP.
source._composer_note: Run WITH scripts: post-autoload-dump fires `php artisan package:discover` (writes bootstrap/cache/packages.php — needed by Laravel, no DB required) and post-install-cmd runs cache:clear/view:clear (file driver, no DB). If the builder lacks APP_KEY and an artisan script errors, add --no-scripts and run `php artisan package:discover --no-interaction` explicitly. vendor/ is pure-PHP (no native build) so it ports cleanly to the offline stage.
source._ext_note: From Ubuntu's packages (runtime_packages): php8.3-gd (Ubuntu's libgd3: freetype, jpeg, png, webp), php8.3-zip, php8.3-mysql (pdo_mysql, mysqli, mysqlnd), php8.3-ldap, php8.3-curl, php8.3-mbstring, php8.3-xml (dom, simplexml, xml, xmlreader, xmlwriter, xsl); opcache, readline and sodium come with php8.3-cli, ctype/fileinfo/iconv/tokenizer/pdo with php8.3-common. source.php_extensions is what the build asserts is loaded in both the Apache and the CLI configuration: the extensions compiled until 2026-10-10 (gd ldap zip pdo_mysql opcache) + composer.lock's platform requirements (curl dom fileinfo gd mbstring xml zip). Nothing is compiled: no docker-php-ext-*, no ldap --with-libdir.

frontend._note: A separate node:22-bookworm vendor sub-stage (or `nodejs` added to the builder) runs `npm ci && npm run production` which builds public/dist (sass css + esbuild js) IN-TREE. Only the built public/dist is needed at runtime; node + node_modules are NOT copied into the runtime image.
